title_sq: Super Dyqan Rruge Kryesore Bulevardi i ri
description_sq:
Qendra e re e Tiranes ( Sheshi Katar ) Bulevardi i ri ! Shitet Dyqan 67.2 metra katror
Vije e pare rruge kryesore 
Perball sheshit Katarit Bulevardi i ri
Pamje nga rruga kryesore
Njolla me ngjyre te kuqe .Dyqani eshte komplet me pamje nga sheshi katar ku para dyqanit kalon rruge kembesori dhe rruge makinash qe do lidhi Bulevardin e ri me Unazen e re . Sheshi Katar pritet te jet qendra e re e Tiranes. Pozicioni me i mire dhe aktraktiv i tiranes si per qytetaret e Shqiperis si dhe per turistet nga e gjithe Bota
title_en: Super Store Main Street New Boulevard
description_en: The new center of Tirana (Qatar Square) the new boulevard! Shop for sale, 67.2 square meters, first line, main street, in front of Katari square, new Boulevard. View from the main street. Red spot. The shop is complete with a view of Qatar square, where in front of the store there is a pedestrian street and a car road that will connect the new Boulevard with the new Ring Road. Qatar Square is expected to be the new center of Tirana. The best and most attractive position of Tirana both for citizens of Albania and for tourists from all over the world
